summary: A short tower on Oahu's lava headland that has held a giant hyperradiant lens since 1909, built after the grounding of the liner Manchuria.

access.note: Coast Guard-owned; tower and its immediate grounds closed; viewable from the public trail to the top of Makapuu Head.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Heights differ: 25 ft to the focal plane (1925 Bulletin), 35 ft (Lighthouse Friends), 46 ft (Putnam, 1917). The 1909 notice calls it a cement-gray tower, consistent with concrete; our record says brick.

corrections.why: Makapuu Point is on Oahu; the NRHP asset record and USLHS place record both give Honolulu County.
Lighthouse Friends says concrete and the 1909 notice calls the tower cement-gray; no source read says brick.

notes_for_editor: Main narrative of construction, keepers' lives and WWII log relies on Lighthouse Friends (second-hand; its logbook quote is not independently verified). NRHP nomination PDF OCR is unusable, so only the NPGallery metadata page is cited. USCG Historian page was blocked (403/404). Newspapers: the Chronicling America queue was congested, so only the 2 Oct 1909 Lighthouse Board notice was read; the Manchuria and Helga groundings, and the Aug 1909 Advertiser/Hawaiian Star hits, were not read. Tower dimensions, lens size and prism count are disputed in sources (see resolved_conflicts); the 1936 Bulletin OCR is column-interleaved, only the lens line was quoted. Toomey death date: Bulletin says 9 April, Lighthouse Friends says noon the next day. Roster: Pestrella USLHS 1960-1962 vs retirement 1963 per Lighthouse Friends; USLHS lists Amalu 1924-1929, Lighthouse Friends 1925-1929. Roster names matched by listing, not table position. The 1925 Bulletin 'Alcana' is OCR for Akana (the Reverend Akana, of Kawaiahao Church, is a different person). Fact-check 2026-10-27: Manchuria position differs (Star-Advertiser: reef 1,500 ft off Waimanalo; Lighthouse Friends: off Makapuu Point), now stated in text. Bulletin page numbers changed to PDF pages. 1925 Bulletin 'Keeper Alcana' linked to roster head keeper Charles K. Akana by date only.
